title: 第八章 清风巡卫

content_zh:
“神棍！几个角了？”霸王问道，知道了林铮也在做任务，他们决定等下做完了就帮他去打食矿兽，当然，关键是他们觉得在一起练级效率不错。林铮任务呢？好了吗？”
“已经完成了，就等你了！”
“嘿嘿！那多不好意思啊！”林铮笑道，不过脸上一点不好意思的样子都看不出来，突然，林铮脸色一变，冲霸王大喊一声：“小心！”还没等霸王反应过来，一支箭“嗖！”地一声便飞了过来，正中霸王的背心。
“霸王！”几人惊叫一声，很快，小喵反应过来，赶紧给霸王加了下血，霸王这才没有在被怪围殴和偷袭中挂掉。
“大家注意了，是‘傲剑’的那些家伙！”霸王马上大叫道，这刚一叫完，一旁的树丛中马上窜出来十几个玩家，全部顶着‘傲剑’为前缀的名字，为首的叫傲剑中华，是一名侠客，一脸的狠戾，似乎和林铮他们有深仇大恨似的。
林铮几人快速地将霸王身边的几只蜥蜴杀掉，然后聚成一团与傲剑一帮人对峙着，林铮悄悄地问了一下身边的蒂娜：“这些家伙什么来头啊？”
“傲剑家族啊，在我们天霜城很有名气的，昨天他们几个家伙想抢我们的boss，结果被我们反杀了，这仇就结下了啰！”蒂法两眼满是无辜地说道。
“哦——原来不是一群好鸟啊！”林铮了然了。玩游戏嘛，抢boss那是正常现象，这抢不过又拉一大票来报复那就有点下作了，这种仗势欺人的做法很让林铮反感。更让林铮气愤的是，那个该死的家伙，居然把他想要注册的名字抢注了！傲剑中华，牛叉哄哄的名字，本来应该是他的！可恨呐！
“霸王重甲，你们昨天杀了我们几个弟兄，这笔账怎么算！”傲剑中华大声喝道。
“呸！”霸王很不屑地说道：“屁话这么多，想打就来，还找什么不要脸的借口，别以为人多了老子就怕你们了！”
“给脸不要脸，给我上！宰了他们！”既然撕破了脸皮，傲剑中华也不再废话了，把剑一挥，身边的玩家便大喊着杀向林铮一队人。
“那个傲剑中华交给我，上！”林铮低喝一声，握紧匕首便冲了上去，霸王几个紧随其后开始攻击，“叮！”林铮的匕首和傲剑中华的剑招架在一起，傲剑中华看着林铮，脸色阴沉地说道：“小子，你不是他们一伙儿的吧！我劝你还是不要谈这趟浑水，赶紧走人，我不和你计较！”
“谁说我们不是一伙儿的！”林铮咧嘴一笑，就在傲剑中华脸色一变之时，林铮在弹开之后伸出左手就给了他一拳，一下将其击退，没等傲剑中华站稳，林铮已经冲了上去，一脚就踢中了他的脸，脚一落地，瞬间便是一记“践踏”，几个想来增援的家伙同时中招，好死不死的还眩晕了！林铮一下乐了！现在的玩家都没有眩晕抗性，5秒的眩晕那是一点都不打折扣，于是，在傲剑中华铁青的脸色中，林铮奸笑着拿着匕首捅了他几下，一下好几百的血啊！几下后，傲剑中华愤怒地吼叫一声，死亡倒地了。倒地后的傲剑中华没有马上复活，亲眼看着林铮极其迅速地将上来支援他的手下一个个捅死，郁闷的差点吐血。同时傲剑中华也有些吃惊，他目前的血防算是不错的了，居然被林铮几下捅死，这家伙的攻击力也太高了，天霜城什么时候多了这号人物！
“嘿嘿，刚好缺蓝你们就给我送来了！”林铮得意的从地上捡起几个小蓝瓶，这东西可贵的紧啊！一个加100点蓝，要价就是10个银币，都是留着应急用的，结果被林铮这一杀，居然掉了不少瓶，看得几个还没复活的傲剑成员肉疼不已！
就在林铮刚捡完东西，正想去帮霸王他们的时候，一道人影突然出现在林铮身边，是一名潜行已久窥伺机会的陷阱猎人，由于林铮捡东西的时候一直警惕着敌人偷袭，这捡完了，反倒是放松了警惕，就在这一瞬间，陷阱猎人出现，一刀捅向了林铮的喉咙！
“太阳的！”这突然出现的猎人把林铮下出了一身冷汗，刀尖都刺破他喉咙的皮肤了，还好，最后关头给他用匕首挡住了。一击不成，眼前的猎人马上一退，快速地退到了战斗区域外，一脱离战斗状态，马上再次潜行消失了。

"Magical stick! How many horns are there?" Overlord asked. Knowing that Lin Zheng was also doing a task, they decided to help him fight the ore-eating beasts after he finished the task. Of course, the key was that they felt that it was efficient to level up together. What about Lin Zheng’s mission? Are you ready? "
“It’s done, just waiting for you! "
"hey-hey! How embarrassing that is! " Lin Zheng smiled, but there was no trace of embarrassment on his face. Suddenly, Lin Zheng's expression changed and he shouted at Overlord: "Be careful! Before the Overlord could react, an arrow "Whoosh!" "With a sound, it flew over and hit the Overlord's vest.
"Overlord! "A few people screamed. Soon, Xiao Miao reacted and quickly added blood to Overlord. Only then did Overlord not die from being surrounded by monsters and sneak attacks.
“Everyone, please pay attention, it’s those guys from ‘Proud Sword’! "The Overlord shouted immediately. As soon as he finished shouting, a dozen players sprang out from the bushes on the side, all with names prefixed with 'Aojian'. The leader was called Aojian Zhonghua. He was a knight, with a ruthless look on his face, as if he had a deep grudge against Lin Zheng and the others.
Lin Zheng and others quickly killed several lizards around Overlord, and then gathered together to confront Ao Jian and his gang. Lin Zheng quietly asked Tina beside him: "What are the backgrounds of these guys? "
"The Aojian Family is very famous in our Tianshuang City. Yesterday, a few of them tried to steal our boss, but we killed them in return. This is the end of the feud! "Tifa said with innocent eyes.
"Oh - it turns out they are not a good group of birds! "Lin Zheng understood. When playing games, it's normal to grab the boss. If you can't win and get a lot of votes to retaliate, it's a bit despicable. This kind of bullying makes Lin Zheng disgusted. What makes Lin Zheng even more angry is that the damn guy actually registered the name he wanted to register! Aojian Zhonghua, the name that Niucha coaxed, should have been his! Hateful!
"Overlord Heavy Armor, you killed several of our brothers yesterday, how do you settle the score! "Aojian Zhonghua shouted loudly.
“Bah! "The Overlord said disdainfully: "You talk so much nonsense, you can hit me whenever you want, and you still find shameless excuses. Don't think that I am afraid of you because there are more people! "
"Shameless, fuck me! Kill them! "Now that he has broken his skin, Aojian Zhonghua stopped talking nonsense. With a wave of his sword, the players around him shouted and killed Lin Zheng and his team.
"Leave that proud sword of China to me, come on! "Lin Zheng shouted low, grasped the dagger and rushed forward. The Overlords followed closely and started to attack, "Ding! "Lin Zheng's dagger and Aojian Zhonghua's sword parried together. Aojian Zhonghua looked at Lin Zheng and said with a gloomy face: "Boy, you are not one of them! I advise you not to talk about this muddy water and leave as soon as possible. I won’t argue with you! "
"Who said we are not in the same group! "Lin Zheng grinned. Just when Aojian Zhonghua's face changed, Lin Zheng stretched out his left hand and punched him after the bounce. He knocked him back. Before Aojian Zhonghua could stand firm, Lin Zheng had already rushed up and kicked him in the face. As soon as his foot landed on the ground , it was a "trampling" in an instant, and several guys who wanted to come for reinforcements were hit at the same time, and they were even stunned! Lin Zheng was so happy! Nowadays, players have no stun resistance, and a 5-second stun is not a discount at all, so, in Proud Sword, With Hua Tieqing's expression on his face, Lin Zheng smiled evilly and stabbed him several times with a dagger, drawing hundreds of blood! After a few blows, Aojian Zhonghua roared angrily and fell to the ground. After falling to the ground, Aojian Zhonghua did not come back to life immediately. He saw Lin Zheng extremely fast. The men who came up to support him were stabbed to death one by one. At the same time, Aojian Zhonghua was also a little surprised. His current blood defense was pretty good, but he was stabbed to death by Lin Zheng several times. This guy's attack power was too high. When did Tianshuang CityThere’s so many more people like this!
"Hehe, I happened to be short of blue, so you brought it to me!" Lin Zheng proudly picked up a few small blue bottles from the ground. These things are so precious and tight! Each adds 100 mana points, and the asking price is 10 silver coins, which are all reserved for emergency use. As a result, Lin Zheng killed a lot of bottles, which made several members of the Proud Sword who had not yet been resurrected feel pain!
Just when Lin Zheng had just finished picking up things and was about to help Overlord and the others, a figure suddenly appeared next to Lin Zheng. It was a trap hunter who had been sneaking around for a long time and was waiting for opportunities. Since Lin Zheng had been alert to enemy sneak attacks when picking up things, he relaxed his vigilance after picking up things. At this moment, the trap hunter appeared and stabbed Lin Zheng in the throat!
"It's from the sun!" The sudden appearance of the hunter made Lin Zheng break into a cold sweat. The tip of the knife even pierced the skin of his throat. Fortunately, he blocked it with a dagger at the last moment. When the attack failed, the hunter in front of him immediately retreated and quickly retreated outside the combat area. As soon as he was out of combat, he immediately disappeared in stealth again.
